com.vector.cfg.workflow.groovy.update

Interface IUpdateApi.IUpdateSettingsApi

  • Enclosing interface:
    IUpdateApi

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public static interface IUpdateApi.IUpdateSettingsApi
    The Interface IUpdateApi.IUpdateSettingsApi provides API to configure common update settings.

    Usage example to set some update settings: 

     
 update(Paths.get("MyProject.dpa")){
   updateSettings{
     updateMode = ECUC_ONLY
     uuidUsageInStandardConfigurationEnabled = false
   }
 }

      • isEcucAndDevWsUpdateExecutable

        @PublishedMethod
boolean isEcucAndDevWsUpdateExecutable()
        Checks if an Ecuc and Developer workspace update is executable with the given project.
        Is Ecuc and Developer Workspace Update executable
        Use isEcucAndDevWsUpdateExecutable() to get the information if an Ecuc and Developer Workspace Update is executable. If this check returns true the EupdateMode can be set to IUpdateApi.EUpdateMode.ECUC_AND_DEV_WS.
        Returns:
        true / false

      • setUpdateMode

        @PublishedMethod
void setUpdateMode(IUpdateApi.EUpdateMode updateMode)
        Sets the update mode.
